subject: FYI: Legal entities used by Enron Credit
before_rationale: Generic Enron Credit operating entity directory.
after_rationale: Identifies the Enron Credit legal-entity and booking map. The sender distinguishes the current entity structure from planned trade booking, making this a record to check against the credit-derivative routing in R170.

subject: Re: BEAR Guarantee letter
before_rationale: Ordinary brokerage-account guarantee replacement and documentation.
after_rationale: The identified Bear Stearns securities-loan agreement and credit book are being assigned from ENA to Enron Credit Inc. The chain separately calls for replacing the Enron Corp guarantee and describes that guarantee as reducing required funding to 20 percent per side.

subject: Re: Swap deal with EPMI Long Term Hedge
before_rationale: Ordinary internal power trade confirmation mechanics.
after_rationale: The chain identifies an ENA hedge with EPMI that was booked as RMT versus EPMI. Legal proposes matching trades through RMT, providing a trace of the actual entities and books used for the hedge.

subject: Re: Enron North America Corp. NYMEX Hedge Exemption Applications
before_rationale: Screened NYMEX trading limit and regulatory hedge exemption application.
after_rationale: ENA owns LV Cogeneration interests directly and through a friendly investor structure. A ten-year swap is part of the project financing, an ENA officer signed for both sides, and the position is tracked in ENA risk books.

subject: Transfer price agreement
before_rationale: Ordinary physical hub-services and peaking-contract profit-sharing terms, without identified financing or accounting discrepancy.
after_rationale: Proposed transfer pricing allocates PERC peaking-facility demand charges and contingent profit between Peoples and Enron. These are cash-flow terms for the project whose separate correspondence discusses off-balance-sheet equipment and contracts (E077).

subject: Swap deal with EPMI Long Term Hedge
before_rationale: Ordinary internal power hedge trade confirmation.
after_rationale: Identifies a specific intra-group power hedge offered by ENA and taken by EPMI, but booked as RMT versus EPMI. The request to confirm under ISDA helps trace the difference between execution and booking.

subject: Re: BEAR Guarantee letter
before_rationale: Ordinary brokerage securities-loan agreement and credit-book assignment.
after_rationale: Clarifies which assets and agreements move from ENA to Enron Credit Inc. under the Bear Stearns assignment that R094 links to Enron Corp credit support. It identifies both the credit book and the securities-loan agreement.

subject: Re: ENA / Enron Credit.com
before_rationale: Ordinary geographic trading booking and tax coordination, no special financing or discrepancy.
after_rationale: Discusses whether back-to-back swaps are needed to transfer credit-derivative positions, where mark-to-market is consolidated, and how to compensate ENA for the risk it assumes when booking differs from risk management.

subject: Re: Authorized Traders
before_rationale: General authorized trader policy update without specific target financing.
after_rationale: Distinguishes the intended capital hedge for the Merchant Portfolio from actual use of the Capital portfolio for CFO and Treasurer mark-to-market positions in Enron stock. It states the capital-market transfer had yet to occur.

subject: Re: Enron Metals
before_rationale: Ordinary intra-group metals trading and tax commission arrangement.
after_rationale: The proposed back-to-back metals trades move remaining economics to Enron Metals Limited while ENA signs the customer trades and is paid a spread for the credit risk it assumes. This traces both transaction routing and residual exposure.

subject: RE: Follow Up to our Meeting
before_rationale: Screened general California trading counterparty exposure coordination, without target financing or accounting discrepancy.
after_rationale: Documents that Portland General Electric California positions were still included in Enron corporate exposure reported to management while a divestiture was being considered. The chain identifies position and earnings reports for tracing the exposure.

subject: Re: BEAR Guarantee letter
after_rationale: Identifies the proposed transfer of the named Bear Stearns securities-loan agreement between ENA and Enron Credit Inc., the same assignment for which R094 discusses replacement Enron Corp support.

subject: FW: EPMI Business
before_rationale: Generic operating business description and entity names, without target financing or accounting discrepancy.
after_rationale: Global Finance asks whether the consolidated wholesale-services description from the 10-K is accurate for ENA or instead describes activities legally performed by EPMI or others. It identifies a concrete entity-level disclosure question.

subject: EnTouch Newsletter
before_rationale: Screened charitable campaign and employee services newsletter, without identified target financing passage.
after_rationale: The newsletter identifies a digital bankruptcy swap in which the shipping desk buys protection from Enron Credit against a Japanese counterparty default. It describes the intra-Enron payout and ties additional protection to shipping mark-to-market profit.
